user.title: Add ESPOID device
user.description: Register an IO node for maintenance from Home Assistant. Wi-Fi service mode is temporary; ordinary AC control remains in Zigbee2MQTT.

data_description.base_url: Local IPv4 address or http:// address of the ESP.
data_description.firmware_base_url: Optional. HA URL reachable by the ESP for firmware downloads, for example http://192.168.1.10:8123. Not the VPN address of your computer.
data_description.mqtt_topic: Optional. Exact device /set topic, including your Zigbee2MQTT prefix.
data_description.discovery_cidr: Optional private IPv4 subnet, at most 256 addresses. Empty suggests /24 from the last IP; that does not verify the mask. Searches start only from the panel.
data_description.check_connection: Leave off when the device is in Zigbee mode.

error.invalid_url: Enter a local IPv4 HTTP address without a path, credentials or query.
error.invalid_topic: Enter an exact MQTT topic ending in /set, without wildcards.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
error.invalid_search_network: Enter a private IPv4 subnet with at most 256 addresses, for example 192.168.1.0/24.
error.already_configured: This device address is already registered.
error.cannot_connect: HA cannot reach the device. Switch it to Wi-Fi service mode, or disable the connection check.
error.invalid_response: The device did not return the expected IO-node service status.
error.response_too_large: The device response exceeds the service limit.
